summary: Tested admin dashboard end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests PASSED (auth guard 401/403, analytics with counts+top_bookmarked, users list w/ role, full CRUD cascade for Category>Book>Chapter>Verse, individual book/chapter cascades w/ auto-updating counts). Frontend: Verified admin visibility gating in Profile, /admin route navigation, dashboard stats & 5 management cards, all sub-screens (categories, books, chapters, verses, users), FABs open modals, end-to-end category creation via UI works and cascade cleanup via API works. Users screen correctly shows ADMIN badge for tzurielsingson only. Hebrew RTL text renders. Book filter chips (chapters/verses) are horizontally scrollable and do not wrap. One non-functional expo-router warning discovered: /app/frontend/app/admin/styles.ts is placed inside the app/ routes dir and is being picked up as a route (warning: 'Route ./admin/styles.ts is missing the required default export').

react_native_issues.issue: Non-layout, non-screen file /app/frontend/app/admin/styles.ts is treated as a route by expo-router, producing repeated console warning: 'Route "./admin/styles.ts" is missing the required default export.' Move to /app/frontend/app/admin/_styles.ts (underscore prefix ignored by router) or relocate outside app/ (e.g., /app/frontend/src/admin/styles.ts). Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/styles.ts

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears on admin styles. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to the unified 'boxShadow' style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/styles.ts (and other places using shadow*)

action_items: Rename /app/frontend/app/admin/styles.ts to /app/frontend/app/admin/_styles.ts (or move to /app/frontend/src/admin/styles.ts) and update imports (currently imported via '@/app/admin/styles' or relative path). This removes the expo-router warning about missing default export.
Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in admin styles to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_analytics has an unused parameter `admin: User = None` — remove it; auth is already handled by require_admin(authorization).
server.py is now ~1043 lines; consider splitting admin routes into a separate router module (routers/admin.py) for maintainability.

server.py DELETE /api/admin/categories checks delete_count first and only after cascades — if category exists but child ops fail, we return success. Consider wrapping cascade + delete in a session/transaction, or at minimum do cascade FIRST, then delete the parent.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data added. Tests use TEST_-prefixed data that is cleaned up (category cascade) at end of each test. One category created via UI (cat_aefb1122711d) was cleaned up via API DELETE.
